parser-errors.brief: The parser accepts trailing commas silently. Report them as errors with line and column, add tests for every case.

cli-json-output.brief: Add --json to every CLI command. Same data as the text output, documented in docs/cli.md, tested.

parser-speed.brief: Make the parser at least 2x faster on bench/large.txt without changing behaviour. Measure before and after, put the numbers in the commit message.
